visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled brown hair and a blue-and-white checkered shirt sits at a desk in a bright office, adjusting a small black lavalier microphone on his lapel while looking directly at the camera. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom. (2) The scene cuts to a large group of people in a brightly lit indoor venue posing in front of a pink backdrop labeled 'SUGAR HIGH'; many are wearing blue outfits and gesturing with 'V' signs. (3) Night sky filled with vibrant green and yellow fireworks exploding in a series of bursts. (4) The man stands between two mascot characters, Chip and Dale, at a theme park; they are gesturing outdoors in front of a Western-style building facade. (5) In a dark outdoor setting at night, the man holds a lit sparkler that emits bright gold sparks. (6) A series of quick cuts follows: a close-up of the man's mouth showing his teeth, then a wide shot of him on a stage in a black leather jacket hosting an event with 'SHISEIDO' and 'ROCKS' branding visible on screens behind him. (7) Close-ups of an English textbook with handwritten notes and a white clock on a wall, followed by an older Caucasian man in a white shirt writing on a whiteboard with red and blue markers. (8) The man prays with incense at a nighttime temple, followed by a close-up of a property contract on a table and him shopping for refrigerators in an electronics store with a woman. (9) A wide shot of a theater stage at an 'Eslite' bookstore where the man and a woman sit in chairs, followed by a high-angle shot of a large seated audience. (10) Shots of food including a hand holding a piece of bread, and the man appearing on a talk show set with a female host. (11) A book titled '再痛也要勇敢' is shown in multiple copies on a bookstore shelf, then the man stands in a lecture hall with a banner for 'Cheers' magazine. (12) The man undergoes a facial treatment with red dots visible on his skin, then appears on stage in a blue shirt singing with a female pop star in a white outfit under concert lights. (13) A gender reveal party with blue and white balloons falling from the ceiling, followed by the man screaming with excitement at a concert with bright stage lights and thousands of fans. (14) A final montage shows a person in a large bear mascot costume amidst a crowd, and the man posing for a mirror selfie in a hallway with three female friends.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 祝福大家新的一年. [Logo]: @關韶文. (2) [Subtitle]: 天天都充滿. [Logo]: SUGAR HIGH. (3) [Subtitle]: 一眨眼這樣就過了一年. (4) [Subtitle]: 回顧這365天的日子. (5) [Subtitle]: 可以說是又忙碌又豐收. (6) [Subtitle]: 一月 牙齒飛出去 主持了好幾場尾牙. (7) [Subtitle]: 二月 去曼谷讀書了一個月 轉換身份 重新開始. (8) [Subtitle]: 三月 過了33歲的生日 買了一間預售屋 當自己的生日禮物 把錢花掉了 再賺就好. (9) [Subtitle]: 四月 在誠品舉辦了 Podcast 負能量週記的見面會 居然來了300多人. (10) [Subtitle]: 五月 我快閃福岡 批發了明太子麵包回台灣 短影音居然破了百萬 掀起每個人外帶風潮. (11) [Subtitle]: 六月 發表了我的第三本新書 再痛也要勇敢 成全自己 分享自己正顎手術的心得. (12) [Subtitle]: 七月 跟全球人壽合作 舉辦了北中南三場講座 見到了好多閃閃發光的眼神. (13) [Subtitle]: 八月 舉辦了我自己的新書簽書會 和台下粉絲聊到哭. (14) [Subtitle]: 九月 去韓國釜山打了麗珠蘭水光針. (15) [Subtitle]: 十月 王心凌2.0巡演開跑 被翻牌點歌 居然還在小巨蛋上台合唱啦. (16) [Subtitle]: 十一月 參加了賴珮如的性別趴 感受到滿滿的溫暖. (17) [Subtitle]: 十二月 看了周杰倫還有張惠妹的演唱會 大巨蛋直接嗨起來耶. (18) [Subtitle]: 這一年過得很充實也很滿足. (19) [Subtitle]: 不知道今年的你有什麼難忘的事情嗎 留言跟我分享吧.
